lines.text: The lords of the Philistines gathered to offer a great sacrifice to Dagon and praised him for delivering Samson.
Samson called out to Dagon and asked for strength once more to repay the Philistines for his eyes.

wrong_details.true: Samson called out to the LORD

lines.text: Samson braced against the two central pillars, said, “Let me die with the Egyptians,” and the temple fell.

wrong_details.wrong: Let me die with the Egyptians
wrong_details.true: Let me die with the Philistines
